summary: ADR promises the installer ships clamscan.exe and freshclam.exe, and the reason text «движок ClamAV не найден»; tauri.conf.json bundles no ClamAV, and the reason text differs
evidence: ADR 0002 consequences; tauri.conf.json has no resources or ClamAV entries; lib.rs:31-35 path check; clamav.rs:43 reason "{path} не найден"
failure_scenario: Release installs also report the engine unavailable. Users read a different message than the ADR describes. Related to FND-0004.
